_comment: Copy to remotion/src/projects/<your-project>/musicPlan.json, then: npm run music -- <your-project>. Times are VIDEO times (title card included): seconds or "m:ss.s". Each section starts where the previous one ends; the last one runs to the end of the video. loudness is the section's level in LUFS before the render's ducking curve: -18 matches the example's music bed, about 3 dB less for tender or quiet parts. Pick a preset from musicStyles.json after hearing samples (npm run music -- <project> --sample=upbeat-acoustic,calm-piano), or replace "preset" with your own "style": { "positive": [...], "negative": [...] } and "bpm". These are the real sections of the example (Sept 2026) video.

sections.name: family-news
styles: soft solo piano with gentle sustained strings
same key and tempo, half-time feel

sections.name: ministry
styles: groove returns: guitar, ukulele, piano, bass

sections.name: vision-and-invitation
styles: brighter and more energetic over time
